summary: Model node:timers/promises setTimeout as a Node timer-backed Promise that fulfills with the supplied value.

target.notes: Integrate with the Node-compatible timer scheduler and existing JsPromise/async-iteration semantics.

semantics.fulfillment: fulfills with value after timer becomes eligible
semantics.delay: default 1 ms with Node timer normalization
semantics.options: ref defaults true; signal may abort
semantics.ordering: fulfillment enters normal Promise reaction/microtask semantics after timer completion

caveats: Task.Delay alone is insufficient if Node ref/unref liveness and event-loop phase behavior are observable.
Promise chaining after fulfillment remains owned by ASYNC.

tests.name: ref false does not keep loop alive
tests.expected_behavior: the pending timer Promise alone does not require the Node process to stay alive
